## Problem Statement
Describe the problem or limitation you are facing. What does the current system lack?

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of the desired behaviour or capability.

## Alternative Approaches
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Offline-First Impact
- [ ] This feature works fully offline
- [ ] This feature has an online fallback (explain below)
- [ ] This feature requires no external dependencies

## Scope
- [ ] Runtime / Lifecycle
- [ ] Database / Storage
- [ ] Deployment / Packaging
- [ ] Diagnostics / Validation
- [ ] Security / Signing
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Testing / Quality

## Additional Context
Add mockups, diagrams, or references to similar systems.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing feature requests for duplicates
- [ ] This aligns with the offline-first architecture philosophy
